correctness_amendment.reason: Exact rational audit found some nominal Delta_n=epsilon candidates below the promise boundary by floating-point roundoff (roughly 1e-20 to 1e-18).
correctness_amendment.repair: Certify the exact normalized rational tail of stored binary probability weights, moving the mixture upward by ulps if necessary; rerun every formal suite.
correctness_amendment.selection: Reuse the original independently selected configurations unchanged; no outcome-based tuning. The same keyed seeds enable paired correction.
correctness_amendment.disclosure: Some v1 sequential/stream aggregate outcomes were inspected before this correctness amendment. This is not a claim of an untouched externally preregistered experiment.

design.primary_question: When do certified polynomial tests save samples relative to competitive count and validation baselines?

reference.note: Strict Wang Poisson branch and FH fixed-sample small-epsilon branch; conservative amplification for 5% risk.

statistical_analysis.errors: Exact one-sided Clopper-Pearson; 95% simultaneous bounds Bonferroni within each frozen suite across all non-Gap method cells. Fixed-suite lower-bound failure metrics use a separate simultaneous family.
statistical_analysis.cost: Equal-weight cell means, Yes/No and synthetic/empirical strata reported separately. CRN paired differences with descriptive 95% normal intervals and bootstrap aggregate intervals.
statistical_analysis.m_star: Smallest tested fixed budget for which all promised synthetic scenarios for the method/n/epsilon pass the simultaneous error upper bound. Report right censoring and do not interpolate as proven power.
statistical_analysis.search: All adversarial search scores retained; selected populations frozen before independent new-seed test. No formal outcomes used for parameter changes.
statistical_analysis.gap: No error labels for S>n and Delta_n<epsilon.
statistical_analysis.scope: Empirical tests are not an optimal-order proof; FH-shaped practical variants are not original FH theorem algorithms; reference empirical supports are not external population truth.

external_limitations: No new ecological field survey or independently established full-lake species inventory is available.
Prospective local timestamp/hash manifest is not an external preregistration.
All new designs were informed by previously inspected v1 results; only this follow-up's outcomes are held out.
